recommended.t: Portable fairy rings or quick access to fairy rings for teleportation between the Shrine of Inanna BKS, Amberfell DLP, and Fenmoor DIQ
Boss portals attuned to Ivar, King of Bones and Silverquill, the Dreadhog for fast access to their respective areas
6 yew planks (for building the Heathervein canoe station, requires 70 Construction)
6 magic planks (for building the Fenmoor canoe station, requires 80 Construction)
40 steel nails (for building both canoe stations)
5 bogwarts (unlocking fairy ring DIQ in Fenmoor, requires 79 Agility)

kills.t: Lady Karmina Ghrazi and Lord Vasily Ghrazi (combined life point pool of 1,000,000).

rewards.t: 25000 Combat XP lamp (requires level 60 in the chosen skill to use) in one of: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic , scl | Necromancy , scl | Prayer or scl | Summoning
Ability to mix super and extreme antisanguine potions
Full access to the rest of Havenhythe
Access to The Ghrazi Blood Knights boss fight

steps.t: Talk to Sorrel in Amberfell (fairy ring code DLP). [Chat: Accept]
Talk to Ash located next to the south-east barricade. [Chat: ~]
Climb over the barricade to continue the dialogue.
Attack and defeat the Sanguine Sigma werewolf on the hill south of Ash. Your antisanguine potion will not be consumed. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: Freedom and antisanguine can remove the bleed.

steps.t: Go back to the barricade and talk to Ash.
Report to Adam in Wendlewick. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Adam again about asking the giants for help before going to Hollow Hill. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Zeke in the neighbouring building to the east. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Liat at the smithy to the south-east (may be wandering outside the building). [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Esther on the floor 1 of the lighthouse to the south-west. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Anya in the Blighted Cave and hand her a silver spine and a sanguine spine. [Chat: Any › Any › 1 Yes] She will make you an empowered antisanguine (silverquill) potion.

sub.t: Use the boss portal at War's Retreat attuned to Silverquill to teleport straight to Anya.

steps.t: Enter the cave ventricle. You will enter a safe non-combat zone. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Pour the potion onto Silverquill who's asleep in her den.
Exit the cave ventricle. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Anya.
Climb over the barricade near Ash in Amberfell.
Run east via Berylbrook, then north to Heathervein. Beware of the sanguine werewolves.

sub.t: If you have level 72 Agility, you may traverse the stepping stones on the river before entering Berylbrook.
(Optional) Repair the canoe station on the eastern outskirts of Heathervein with level 70 Construction using 6 yew planks and 20 steel nails.

steps.t: Head to the Exalted Quarry and go to the lowest level by traversing the broken ladders.
Talk to Aurora in the centre of the quarry, then climb up any ladder.

Mine any essence vein (level 65 Mining), essence deposit (level 85 Mining) or large essence deposit (level 105 Mining) until multiple essence lumps, chunks or slabs have been obtained. You need to keep mining until the vein becomes cracked, before you can obtain some.
Mine the exalted colossus to turn your regular lumps, chunks or slabs into exalted essence lumps, chunks or slabs.
Ensure you have kept an exalted essence lump, chunk, or slab to give to Esther later. There is a bank deposit box next to Azur.
Process exalted essence lumps, chunks, or slabs into exalted essence on the essence processor near Azur, which will automatically be deposited to the bank.
Use the Heathervein bank to make a super antisanguine potion by mixing an unfinished kwuarm potion with an exalted essence.
Talk to Samson in the smithing house in Heathervein and learn how to create a havensilver halberd.
Create a havensilver halberd on the anvil outside of Samson's house.
Head to Wendlewick.
Talk to Esther at the lighthouse with an exalted essence lump, chunk or slab in the backpack. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Show the halberd to Liat at the smithy in Wendlewick. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Zeke in the house east of Adam. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Talk to Adam. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.]
Enter the cave in Hollow Hill and talk to Fox inside. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Heralds of Crimson'.] You will receive 3 giant logs and 3 (quest) ropes.

sub.t: Use the boss portal at War's Retreat attuned to Ivar for a nearby teleport to the Hollow Hill cave.

steps.t: Head out of the cave and west up the mountain to the volatile chinchompa hunting spot.
Around the hunting area, build and then set 3 unbuilt log trap. Each log trap requires two actions to complete.
Return to Wendlewick and talk to Adam.
Head to the Shrine of Inanna.
Talk to Inanna to confront the Ghrazi. Continue the dialogue with Anya to start the fight with the Ghrazi. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is in Hollow Hill. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Raz to the west outside her hut and witness her fight, afterwards, talk to Raz again.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is in Hollow Hill. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Trigger the traps you made earlier. The werewolves will have three glowing yellow birds flying around them when they're in position to trigger the traps.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is near the farm. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Calm Silverquill, far east of the farm outside the Blighted Cave.
Watch Silverquill's fight.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is near the farm. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Talk to Ben, northeast of the farm. Choose any spell if available. [Chat: Any] If you do nothing or don't act quickly enough, Inanna will intervene and you can move to the next step.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is in Wendlewick. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Head east of the lodestone to the smithy.
Defeat the 3 Sanguine Omegas (level 78). You may use Protect from/Deflect Melee prayers.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is in Wendlewick. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Head east of the lodestone.
Defeat the 4 Sanguine Omegas (level 78). You may use Protect from/Deflect Melee prayers.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna again. She will sense trouble and teleport, telling you to follow her howls.
Talk to Anya, she will tell you Inanna is in Wendlewick. She can teleport you there. [Chat: 1 Where's Inanna? › 1 Yes.]
Repair the lighthouse barricade.
Talk to Inanna. She will teleport you back to the shrine.
Talk to Inanna at the shrine.
Head to the Burnt Lobster Tavern in Wendlewick and talk to Adam, Zeke or Esther.
Head to the Shrine of Inanna and inspect Anya's parasol.
Head back to the tavern and talk to Adam, Zeke or Esther. They will tell you to find an experienced tracker in Amberfell.
Travel to Amberfell (canoe station [Chat: 4 Amberfell] if repaired) and talk to Ash near the barricade.
Head to the Shrine of Inanna and talk to Ash to start tracking Anya and Inanna. [Chat: 1 Yes.]

Track Anya's parasol and follow the rainbow orb to the east. You do not have to wait for the orb to reach its destination; but you need to head to the next object to trigger the dialogue and then continue tracking immediately.
Track the flower planter on the southeast side of the house at Eastfold Farm.
Track Anya's chest found in Anya's camp to the south.
Track the bloodsplatter to the east, just north-east of the Deserted Mine. Finish the conversation with Ash and wait for him to teleport in order to meet you outside Moonsylvar Wood.
Travel to Amberfell, climb over the barricade and go east, then go south before reaching Berylbrook.
Enter Moonsylvar Wood south-west of Berylbrook and follow the following paths:

sub.t: Track the log at the crossroads
Track the dead bear in the south-west
Middle south (just south-east of the bear)

steps.t: Travel east through Fenmoor then north-east to Shuruk-Ba. Watch out for the aggressive ravenous strigoi which attack with Magic just outside Shuruk-Ba.
Recommended to bank in Linbog Village to prepare for combat.
p: Surviving the Ghrazi Blood Knights instant kill attack.

steps.t: (Optional) Repair the canoe just north of Linbog Village (requires 6 magic planks and 20 steel nails, as well as level 80 Construction; if you didn't get the magic planks, you can use the Plank Make spell on some magic logs at the bank).
(Optional) Repair the fairy ring east of Linbog Village with 5 bogwart mushrooms (requires level 79 Agility).
Enter the Crimson Gate in the eastern-most part of Shuruk-Ba. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Talk to Anya or Inanna to begin the fight (this is not a safe fight). [Chat: Any › Any › 5. You're not taking Inanna (Continue Quest)].
After the cutscene click the floor to continue.
Continue the chat, then click the floor again.
Talk to Anya or Inanna [Chat: Any].
Quest complete!
